body: Ritz-Carlton Development Co. (RCDC), a division of Marriott International Inc., asked the Colorado Court of Appeals to hold that the Eagle County Assessor erred in doubling the previous valuation of 54 condominium units attached to the Ritz-Carlton Bachelor Gulch Hotel and Spa in Beaver Creek, Bloomberg Tax reported. The units are divided into 648 ownership interests, each entitling its owner to 21 days of use a year.

On Thursday, November 5, 2026, the court sided with the county in an unpublished opinion, rejecting RCDC's argument based on a two-step analysis, according to Bloomberg Tax. The portion of the article available without a subscription does not give the dollar values involved, the tax year, or the rest of the court's reasoning.

timeline.label: Colorado Court of Appeals affirms the county's valuation in an unpublished opinion
